verdict.rationale: The service page names professional intermediaries who may use the service (lawyers, notaries and solicitors authenticating with their bar-issued certificate). It also states that the generated pact must be digitally signed by all partners, which implies founders' signatures stay personal. SCAP lets people sign in the capacity of their company role. However, there is no published authorization or mandate form, and nothing explicitly lists what a third-party representative may or may not do on a founder's behalf. Missing for 10: published authorization/mandate forms, an explicit scope of permitted versus forbidden third-party actions, an explicit statement of which signatures cannot be delegated, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
